scenarios.name: colorless-spell-costs-two-less
scenarios.why: Eldrazi Devastator is colorless, and Ugin reduces its eight generic mana cost by two; six colorless mana pays the remainder.

scenarios.name: colored-spell-keeps-its-generic-component
scenarios.why: Grizzly Bears is green, not colorless, so Ugin's reduction does not apply; its generic component still requires mana in addition to green.
